quest.title: The Third Experiment: Life
quest.description: After the elemental flow tests, Albedo asks you to display any special, otherworldly abilities you may have, though nothing comes of this. Still, Albedo's interest in you has not waned in the least...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Head to the location of the next experiment

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You... You want us to jump!? From up here!?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Not necessarily — not if you know of a better method, that is.

choices.text: We'd better have a better method.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Whichever method you choose, the experiment will end when you reach the opposite shore of the lake.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I will factor the time expended and your top speed into my comparative analysis.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The opposite side of the lake... So... We're gonna be swimming?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Without limitations, we complete tasks intuitively using the method that seems most rational to us.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Some of us would be unable to stand the icy waters... Others might find the whole thing rather refreshing.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: No matter what choice you make, it's all a part of the experiment. For me, every detail is invaluable to the research.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Then if you would, please. I eagerly await the results.

choices.text: This is actually less stressful than the superpower part.

talks.objective: Reach the location that Albedo designated
Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Great work, I've never seen a performance quite like it.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Your reputation precedes you, Traveler. The data shows that you're easily outperforming the average citizen in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you followed us the whole way without breaking a sweat!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Me? Actually, I used alchemy to cheat a little, but anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If it turns out that the natural laws of Teyvat do not affect you, I should be able to make various inferences about the otherworldly civilization you belong to.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If the natural laws of Teyvat do affect you, then I shall be able to make inferences into the kind of evolution that would occur under the absence of such effects.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The innumerable possibilities that this could present, the captivating insights... It will be something to savor again and agai—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Buuuut how does this help your RESEARCH?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You've helped me to unravel many of the problems that were holding it back. When we return to the campsite, I should be able to show you something interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What else have you researched this thoroughly?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I may be about to make some analogies between you and a few... unusual specimens. I hope you won't be offended.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Gold, Petrified Trees, a sun eight times the size of our own...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The essence of the investigative process is enthralling, but such feelings are inevitably fleeting in nature.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I'm willing to pour all my energy into research, and yet specimens are finite. As the unknown transitions into the realm of scientific understanding, the feeling of enlightenment is lost.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: All these things that start out as objects of fascination end up possessing the prosaic mundanity of a Sunsettia or a Sweet Flower. They cease to be noteworthy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... So that's why you wanted to paint those hilichurls? Because you got to see something new and interesting in the differences between them?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Precisely. To quote my exact words from earlier, these creatures are, for the most part, "quite boring... not worth closer inspection." There is precious little about them that serves to pique my curiosity now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So after all these experiments, are we gonna be, like, boring to you? Like some basic draft of a sketch?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Of course not. You have been of great assistance to me, and I will remember this friendship for a lifetime.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Now, before we head back to the campsite, there's one more experiment: intelligence.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Follow me, there are some other ruins nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So if we do decide to go swimming, you gonna dive in with us?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: No, unless you're thinking of conducting competitive research?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, uhh... Forget Paimon said anything.
